event_text: Keio finds a ransomware attack on its group's servers, cuts off its network and reports it to the police
Keio says a group claiming to be the attacker says it has published some of the group's data
Keio says outside experts report that data the attacker says it stole has been published, and reports a possible personal data leak to the regulator
Keio publishes its findings: about 12,000 people's data confirmed leaked, up to about 10.63 million customers and partners possibly affected
The Japan Times reports the attack has been linked to the ransomware group Qilin, citing a tracker
